newsitem.title: UK: Euro oil swaps steady after falls, mogas up $1.
newsitem.headline: Euro oil swaps steady after falls, mogas up $1.

text.p: European oil swaps were mostly steady on Tuesday in a sideways market bar slightly firmer gasoline and marginally easier Brent CFDs.
Fuel and naphtha were essentially unchanged.

Brent CFDs were a touch weaker with the balance of this week at -20 cents against September from -17/18 cents while July 21-25 lost one cent to -23 cents. July 28 to August 1 was holding around -26 cents and August 4-8 steady at -27/28 cents.
A couple of CFDs traded. July 21-25 at -23 cents against September and a July 15-18 against July 21-25 roll was done at +3 cents.
Gasoline pegged at $185-186 on August with July little talked about $1 a tonne lower while naphtha was thinly talked with August at $181.50 or so.
Heavy fuel was slow with July valued at $86.50, unchanged from yesterday with August about 50 cents in contango and September a further 75 cents in contango.
Low sulphur swaps were also steady with August around $93.50-94 and September about $1 stronger.
Gas oil crack spreads were valued at $4.25 for 4Q97 and $4.40 for 1Q98 and $4.05 for 2Q98.
